item.title: Nepal tragedy: Owners missing, dog refuses to leave flood-hit Trishuli home
item.description: A black-and-white dog remains at the site of four homes destroyed by a flood. He refuses to leave the muddy patch where his home once stood. Rescue workers and JCBs clear debris around the steadfast canine. Volunteers offer food and water, which he accepts quietly when alone. Displaced residents understand his loyalty to his former territory.
item.dc:creator: VISHANT AGARWALA

item.title: No roofs, no toilets, no teachers: TOI check finds minuses in Rajasthan govt schools
item.description: TOI reporters visited govt schools in 6 Rajasthan districts after the CJP row. The findings show how basic govt schooling has collapsed in pockets of the state, from the coaching capital of Kota to desert villages and Jhalawar’s tragedy-hit Piplodi.
item.dc:creator: RAJIV SAXENA AND VAISHALI PITLIYA

item.title: Haldwani ‘purification’ row: Day after FIR against Rahul, BJP, Cong trade barbs
item.description: The Congress party slammed the FIR against Rahul Gandhi, calling it casteist. BJP countered that Rahul raised the issue belatedly after a threat from Kharge. An FIR was registered against Rahul Gandhi under various sections and the SC/ST Act. The complainant alleged Rahul gave a caste angle to cleaning work at the rally. Uttarakhand CM stated state residents are unaware of Kharge's caste.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Major shake-up in Pakistan cricket: Seven players, coaches Sarfaraz, Gul released
item.description: Following a string of losses, the Pakistan Cricket Board has made significant changes by releasing seven players and parts of the coaching staff. Five new uncapped players have been brought on board, while Sarfaraz Ahmed and Umar Gul step aside from their coaching positions. Mike Hesson and Ashley Noffke will now oversee the coaching duties as the team readies itself for the third Test match against England at Edgbaston.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Government terms arbitration award on Indus Waters Treaty ‘illegal’
item.description: In a decisive move, India has dismissed an arbitration court's ruling related to the Indus Waters Treaty, asserting that the court lacks authority over sovereign matters. This echoes India's previous stance on a similar arbitration award. The Permanent Court of Arbitration urged India to respect its treaty obligations, but India firmly reaffirms that its suspension of treaty enforcement remains effective.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Oracle layoffs: Company leadership may again send the '6 am' email on September 1
item.description: Oracle employees expect layoff emails on September 1, the day its fiscal second quarter begins, with managers asked to submit lists of affected employees and some teams facing double-digit cuts. Staff fear a repeat of March 31, when a 6 am email from "Oracle Leadership" told 10,000 workers their role was eliminated. Oracle has already cut 21,000 jobs this fiscal year while spending $55.7 billion on AI data centres.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: It's time to move from endless war to end of war: PM Modi to Putin
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged President Vladimir Putin to end the ongoing conflict. He emphasized that humanity's well-being depends on moving from endless war to peace. India supports all efforts to resolve issues peacefully and swiftly. Discussions also covered expanding cooperation in various key sectors. Both leaders agreed to maintain contact to strengthen their partnership.
item.dc:creator: SACHIN PARASHAR

item.title: Iran president meets PM Modi, seeks help to end war
item.description: Prime Minister Modi convened with Iranian President Pezeshkian to advance discussions on fortifying trade connections between their nations. Both leaders acknowledged the critical role of maritime freedom and trade in the region. They also discussed the ongoing situations in West Asia, focusing on the importance of Chabahar port collaboration. President Pezeshkian encouraged India to mediate for peace, underscoring their shared dedication to enhancing bilateral economic cooperation.
item.dc:creator: SACHIN PARASHAR

item.title: OpenClaw that Sam Altman spent billions on gets 'largest update in its history'
item.description: OpenClaw has unveiled its most comprehensive software upgrade yet with the arrival of version 2.0. This update enhances user accessibility significantly and integrates features for multi-user collaboration. Installation has been streamlined, along with expanded cross-platform automation tools. The redesigned browser interface provides a centralized workspace that improves navigation, while sophisticated routines and enhanced information retrieval tools elevate the overall user experience.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Developer bought 83 acres near Yosemite for $4m; US weighs land swap for road
item.description: A Nevada-based developer that bought 83 acres outside Yosemite for $4 million in 2024 is seeking a land exchange with the US government. The proposal could give the private property a direct road through a quarter-mile strip of Yosemite National Park. The same access plan was rejected in earlier legal battles, but the Trump administration is now considering it.

item.title: On his last day as Apple CEO, Tim Cook sends memo to employees
item.description: Tim Cook has sent his final memo to Apple employees on his last day as CEO, telling staff he is not leaving Apple but stepping away from a role he loved. John Ternus takes over as Apple CEO on September 1, while Cook becomes executive chairman. Read Tim Cook's full memo, his praise for Ternus, and what the handover means for Apple's hardware-first next chapter.

item.title: Economy grew 7.8% in Q1 despite Iran crisis and El Nino conditions
item.description: India's economy recorded impressive growth of 7.8% during the April to June quarter, driven by a thriving manufacturing sector and a strong services industry. Domestic demand surged, bolstered by significant increases in investment and exports. Reflecting this positive trend, the government has upgraded growth projections for prior financial years, showcasing the economy's robust resilience in the face of global challenges.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: D4vd’s private lawyers withdraw from case: Why did he switch to a public defender?
item.description: D4vd’s private attorneys have withdrawn from representing him in the murder case involving 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. During an August 31, 2026 hearing, the Los Angeles County Public Defender’s Office was appointed as his new legal team. Burke has pleaded not guilty, remains jailed without bail and faces multiple charges. After a July preliminary hearing found enough evidence for trial, his next court appearance is expected in October 2026.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Aaron Donald returns to Rams: Can he and Myles Garrett form the NFL’s best duo?
item.description: Aaron Donald’s comeback to the Los Angeles Rams for the 2026 season marks a thrilling return from retirement. Joining forces with the talented edge Myles Garrett, they form an intimidating pass rush that will test the mettle of any quarterback. With aspirations of clinching a Super Bowl title in their home stadium, this partnership heralds a fresh wave of defensive excellence for the Rams, reviving hopes for passionate fans.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Nepal floods: Avalanche raced down Himalayas at 167 kmph, triggering deadly deluge
item.description: A sudden ice-rock avalanche plummeted down the Himalayas, wreaking havoc in Nepal with catastrophic floods. This swift phenomenon covered extensive ground in mere moments, and scientists ruled out a glacial lake outburst flood as the cause. The disaster wreaked havoc on Nepal's hydropower facilities, prompting a call for further inquiries into the geological processes that led to this calamity.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: IMD predicts below-normal rainfall over India in September
item.description: September rainfall across India is predicted to be below normal, concluding the monsoon season deficiently. August was the warmest on record, with several regions experiencing record high temperatures. Cumulative rainfall from June to August shows a significant deficit, impacting agricultural sowing and increasing irrigation costs. Strong El Niño conditions are expected to persist, negatively affecting monsoon rainfall patterns. Neutral Indian Ocean Dipole conditions will not benefit the monsoon this year.
item.dc:creator: VISHWA MOHAN

item.title: India’s GPS problem: Why the armed forces need NavIC to work
item.description: India's NavIC satellite system, crucial for military and civilian use, currently has only three operational satellites. This shortfall impacts its ability to provide accurate positioning and navigation services. The system's reliability issues stemmed from imported atomic clocks, now being replaced by indigenous ones. Upcoming launches aim to restore the full constellation's functionality. This indigenous capability is vital for India's strategic autonomy and modernization efforts.

item.title: From exam reforms to school reforms: How CJP is changing political discourse
item.description: Student protests for improved school conditions have shifted from cities to villages across India. The Cockroach Janata Party's campaign exposed poor government school infrastructure in several states. State governments responded with new regulations and accelerated development projects. Political parties are now focusing on youth outreach and educational issues. This movement highlights youth as potential game-changers in electoral politics.
item.dc:creator: KUNAL VARMA

item.title: 43km, 0 stops & defunct CCTV: Security gaps exposed in Delhi-NCR bus gang rape case
item.description: A heartbreaking incident in Greater Noida has emerged, where a 16-year-old girl was reportedly gang-raped by a bus driver and conductor. After picking her up during a rainstorm, the assailants left her stranded near Kashmere Gate post-assault. The police responded promptly, capturing the culprits by tracking the bus, evoking memories of the Nirbhaya case that shocked the nation.
item.dc:creator: PRACHI KUMAWAT

item.title: US signs 7-year deals to boost THAAD & Patriot missile production
item.description: The Pentagon has secured seven-year agreements with defense contractors. These deals aim to increase production of critical missile subcomponents. This effort supports the THAAD and PAC-3 MSE interceptor programs. The agreements will strengthen the missile defense industrial base. Higher production volumes and faster deliveries are now expected.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: India name 26-member squad for big friendlies against Brazil, Uruguay and Panama
item.description: India's head coach Khalid Jamil has officially unveiled a 26-member squad as the team gears up for an intense series of international matches. The Blue Tigers will challenge themselves against esteemed squads from Panama, Brazil, and Uruguay. This series serves as a prime opportunity to evaluate the team's strengths against formidable rivals.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Badshah, Isha Rikhi announce divorce after five months of marriage
item.description: Rapper Badshah and actress Isha Rikhi have officially announced their separation after weeks of swirling rumors. They revealed the news via similar statements on their Instagram Stories. This marks the end of Badshah's second marriage; he has a daughter from his first. The couple urged for privacy and requested a halt to any further speculation about their lives.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Messi’s 10 most iconic moments as Argentina legend retires from int'l football
item.description: Lionel Messi has decided to retire from international football at 39, marking the end of an extraordinary era for Argentina. After an impressive career spanning nearly two decades, Messi guided his national team to triumph in the 2021 Copa America and the 2022 World Cup, as well as reaching the final of the 2026 World Cup. His departure signifies a deeply emotional farewell to a remarkable journey.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Rohit Sharma show premiere set: Cricketer makes TV debut with Family Full House
item.description: Rohit Sharma is set to grace television screens with his debut show, 'Family Full House,' which will air on September 19, 2026. As fans eagerly await the iconic cricketer's signature dialogues, he remains active in ODIs while stepping back from other cricket formats. The channel will also be home to beloved shows like 'Kaun Banega Crorepati' and the 'Indian Game Show.'
item.dc:creator: etimes.in

item.title: ‘Where are the jobs?’ Congress challenges PM Modi after 7.8% Q1 GDP growth data
item.description: India's economy grew by 7.8 percent in the April-June quarter. Congress questioned the growth's impact on jobs and prosperity. Prime Minister Modi described the performance as an exemplary and herculean feat. Opposition leaders cited concerns about investment and consumer confidence. They also highlighted issues like unemployment and falling real wages.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Gold pledged for loan stolen in bank robbery: How borrower won case for full value
item.description: So, what happens if gold jewellery pledged against a gold loan is stolen from the bank? For a borrower, the loss can raise a bigger question than simply recovering the value of the gold. Should the bank pay only for the metal, or should the compensation also cover making charges and the value of stones?
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Why is it illegal to take sand from some beaches? Reasons you should know
item.description: Removing sand from beaches carries hefty penalties due to its dire environmental consequences. Destinations like Sardinia and Hawaii impose stringent laws against the extraction of sand, pebbles, or shells, as these elements play a crucial role in combating coastal erosion and nurturing marine life. In India, rampant illegal sand mining devastates neighborhoods and ecosystems alike, exhausting this precious resource and igniting lasting repercussions.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: ‘I don’t have anything more to give’: Lionel Messi retires from int'l football
item.description: Lionel Messi has officially announced his retirement from international football, wrapping up a remarkable chapter in his illustrious career. He described this decision as both difficult and necessary, highlighting the timing as crucial. In his statement, Messi expressed deep appreciation for his fans, noted the significance of nurturing emerging young players, and leaves the sport with fulfillment and dignity.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Vance says Trump’s dramatic Kharg Island post was meant as a signal to Iran
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance stated Donald Trump's social media post conveyed a message to Iran. American military officials confirmed no strikes occurred on Kharg Island overnight. An Iranian official dismissed Trump's post as laughable and not credible. US forces did attack two Iranian launchers on Larak Island recently. These developments renew security concerns in the Strait of Hormuz.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Pakistan crisis deepens after Lord’s rout: Rizwan, Imam-ul-Haq set to return home
item.description: Following a string of embarrassing losses to England, significant changes are on the horizon for Pakistan's Test team. Reports indicate that wicketkeeper-batter Mohammad Rizwan and opener Imam-ul-Haq will be sent back home. In light of the team's disappointing performance, senior officials from the Pakistan Cricket Board convened for an urgent meeting to address rising concerns over both players and coaching strategies.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: ‘Uncertainties’ rising: Xi calls for stronger cooperation in meeting with Putin
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping met at the SCO summit. They discussed strengthening bilateral ties and international regional issues. Cooperation in artificial intelligence and digital innovation was also a key topic. Russia proposed making the bilateral visa-free regime permanent for Chinese citizens. The leaders also touched upon the Ukraine conflict during their talks.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA
